items.html: And it follows that at the time of the sawing she takes the Gevurot from ZA, and he remains only with the Hasadim, and he takes the inner aspect. (And it seems to me that NRN is called the inner aspect of the worlds. And also in another place, see there: the small Tzitzit is the Katnut, which is the Asiya within Yetzirah, and the large Tzitzit is the Gadlut within Yetzirah. And in another place it was explained that both are called the external aspects of Yetzirah. And in another place, see there — from the Ari, of blessed memory — that everything the male gives to the female at the time of the sawing, even what was given to her from Ima, is only the Gevurot, and they are called Achoraim.)
